sources.title: Geodesic Research | The shortest path to impact
sources.snippet: Geodesic Research is a UK-based technical AI safety organisation focused on compute-intensive alignment research. Our seminal work on alignment pretraining showed that you can bake alignment priors into base models, and the broader field is now converging on the approach. Long-horizon capabilities reinforcement learning is emerging as a critical and underexplored threat to alignment ...
